- Added new files: fetch_review_v2.py, render_report.py, and report_template.md to support modular data fetching and report rendering.
- Improved code structure for generating daily A-share market reports.
- Enhanced maintainability and separation of data fetching, templating, and report output logic.

- Add English descriptions: All major documentation sections now include accurate English translations for international users.
- Updated skill name: Consistently use "china-stocks-daily-review" (English, no hyphen).
- Expanded multilingual trigger words and out-of-scope lists for clarity.
- No code logic or functional changes. Documentation updates only.
